name: libtcod/libtcod
description: The classic roguelike toolkit providing true color console, pathfinding, field-of-view, noise generation, and tile-based terminal emulator. The foundational library for traditional roguelike development across C, C++, and Python.
score_rationale: 1.2k-star de-facto standard roguelike toolkit with decades of use, actively maintained through 2026 with broad language support.
summary: Industry-standard roguelike library with pathfinding, FOV, and multi-language support
